hook.name: MeridianHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook managing Meridian launch pools: single-sided concentrated liquidity positions (token-only, LP locked). Skims fees from buy inputs via beforeSwap delta and sell outputs via afterSwap delta, splitting between protocol, creator, and an optional holder distributor. Includes an anti-snipe fee that decays linearly from a higher rate to the base fee over a configurable post-launch window.
